description:
Save a customer delivery shipping address mapped to the active region in ~/.polopan/region.json.

Matches Flutter app (newapp) address schema: firstName, lastName, address1, address2, city, province, zip, country, phone, email, type.

address2.description: Apartment, suite, unit, landmark, or area

country.description: Destination country code or natural name. Defaults to active region country.

id.description: Optional existing address ID to update

is_default.description: Set this address as default for the country (default true)

phone.description: Recipient contact phone number with country dialing code

storage_mode.description: Storage destination: 'local' (writes to ~/.polopan/region.json) or 'stateless' (returns for chat context without disk write). Defaults to 'stateless' in cloud-hosted environments.

zip.description: Postal code / Zip code / PIN code

name: address.save
title: Save or Update Delivery Address
